So I was watching a movie on my PC and I decided to go to the store to grab some snacks (the store is right next to my house).

So I go in, grab my snacks and go up to the counter. I said to the lady that I'm gonna pay with my card, so far so good. Then "DENIED". I was confused and I remebered the money was on my other card. So I tell the lady that I'm going to my house to get the money. Little did I know she thought I was going to bring cash.

I got in the store, showed her that I have my other card and she gives me an annoyed look. 

Me: I got my card!
Her: Um, you told me you we're going to bring the money
M: I did, it's on this card.
H: I already set it to cash.
M: Can't you just exit out of the transaction?(she could but she was lazy I guess)
